title: IRDAI — Insurance regulatory package
summary: Approved licence for **ProTec General Insurance** (JV: M. Pallonji Group + True North's Divya Sehgal) — IRDAI's **4th** insurance licence approval in CY2026...

items: Approved licence for **ProTec General Insurance** (JV: M. Pallonji Group + True North's Divya Sehgal) — IRDAI's **4th** insurance licence approval in CY2026
Operationalised **Policyholders' Education & Protection Fund (PEPF)** under Sec 16A, IRDA Act 1999

Mandated tagging of authorised salespersons to every policy; replaced periodic intermediary licence renewal with perpetual registration + annual fee (non-refundable, higher of ₹10,000 or 0.04% of commission/receipts)
Marketing-firm principal officers/salespersons: ≥25 hrs training every 3 yrs

Insurers allowed to invest up to 20% in AA-rated+ operational infra SPVs; AIF/VCF/private-co cap: 3% (life) / 5% (general); promoter-group exposure capped at 5%; repo/G-sec lending capped at 25% or ₹10,000 cr (lower)
Amended regulations aligned with Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, 2025 (100% FDI in insurers); approved new Penalties Regulations, 2026
HQ IRDAI: Hyderabad | Chairman: Ajay Seth | Estd: 1999

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → ProTec = IRDAI's 4th 2026 licence; PEPF under Sec 16A IRDA Act 1999; training reqt (25 hrs/3 yrs); life vs general AIF/VCF caps (3% vs 5%).
